description: The code map (ADR 0050, AS9): each public claim about Septena and the file in this repo that keeps it. septena.app/llms.txt and the site's open-source section render this list; the site build fails when a path is missing on main, and scripts/gen-registries.mjs --check fails when a path is missing here. A path that ends in / is a folder. `feature` is an ID in registry/capabilities.json. Labels are public copy: no platform names.
